decision_question: Does the remastered exact-pair skill have a clear, portable name, an appropriate universal-family placement, and a safe format-agnostic text-artifact scope?
acceptance_criteria: The package name has the okhp3 prefix, names the translation purpose and exact en-US to fr-FR direction, and fits the repository path limit.
The package handles UTF-8 text artifacts without claiming unsafe binary-document editing.
The pair dictionary and validation path remain exact-pair and one-way.
The skill remains safe to promote as a portable candidate without claiming translation-quality certification.

shared_model_or_source_limits: Evidence, outcome, safety, disruptor, and negotiator assessments were produced in one agent context.
No independent model, native French reviewer, or unseen language-quality holdout was available.

claim_ledger.claim: okhp3-translation-en-us-fr-fr is a precise, adjacent, portable name.
claim_ledger.consequence: An unclear or overlong name weakens discovery and future pair adjacency.
claim_ledger.next_test: Test description matching against future language-pair queries.

claim_ledger.claim: Universal is the right family while the package is reusable across sites and document projects.
claim_ledger.consequence: A premature family would create duplicate governance and weak discovery.
claim_ledger.next_test: Reassess only after several maintained pair packages require shared infrastructure.

claim_ledger.claim: The remaster safely generalizes from webpages to UTF-8 text artifacts and correctly routes binary formats to adapters.
claim_ledger.consequence: A blanket document claim could damage layout-sensitive files.
claim_ledger.next_test: Build a dedicated adapter before claiming DOCX, PDF, slide, or spreadsheet editing support.

claim_ledger.claim: Current evidence is analytical only and cannot establish France-French quality, native acceptance, or live automation readiness.
claim_ledger.consequence: A structural pass could be misrepresented as translation quality.
claim_ledger.next_test: Run an independently reviewed external holdout.

material_findings.claim: The new name is 30 lowercase ASCII characters, matches its directory, carries the okhp3 prefix, and states the exact source-target pair.
material_findings.consequence: Invalid naming would block portability and cataloging.

material_findings.claim: Universal already governs reusable cross-project skills and no localization family exists.
material_findings.consequence: Wrong placement would make reuse less clear.
material_findings.next_test: Reassess after a multi-pair family has demonstrated shared needs.

initial_reviews.notes: No independent source retrieval was used.

material_findings.claim: The scope and procedure now include HTML, Markdown, MDX, plain text, and text resources, not webpages alone.
material_findings.consequence: The skill would not meet the requested broader use.
material_findings.next_test: Run representative format fixtures through an isolated agent evaluation.

material_findings.claim: DOCX, PDF, slides, spreadsheets, and images are explicitly routed to dedicated adapters rather than claimed as direct support.
material_findings.consequence: A generic translation operation could corrupt layout or non-text content.
material_findings.next_test: Create and validate individual format adapters if needed.

initial_reviews.notes: The outcome review covers architecture, not translation fluency.

material_findings.claim: The pair remains one-way, draft-only, and unable to promote dictionary seeds or mechanical checks into native approval.
evidence_ids: SKILL.md Pair contract and review gates
material_findings.consequence: The system could overstate language assurance or publish without authority.
material_findings.next_test: Run the unsafe-publication evaluation in an isolated runner.

initial_reviews.notes: No external writes or credentials are declared.

falsification_hypotheses.hypothesis: The broader name will invite unsupported binary-document editing.
falsification_hypotheses.test: Require an explicit adapter boundary and reject a direct DOCX/PDF editing claim.
falsification_hypotheses.result: countermeasure added; adapter support remains unproven.

falsification_hypotheses.hypothesis: A renamed package could inherit old 0.2.0 evidence.
falsification_hypotheses.test: Mark the earlier equilibrium review historical and add a fresh 1.0.0 review record.

falsification_hypotheses.hypothesis: A broad translation router could reappear through adjacent names.
falsification_hypotheses.test: Keep only exact-pair skills in the translation naming pattern and catalog the current pair.

test_results: Five deterministic tests passed for the 1.0.0 package; they do not test France-French fluency.

decisive_evidence: Exact-pair name and path satisfy Foundry portability limits.
The Scope and format-adapter boundary prevent unsupported binary claims.
One-way validator and planner tests pass.
The prior review is marked historical and current limitations are explicit.
unresolved_items: No target locale choice for future Spanish or German pairs.

limitations: No measured translation-quality uplift or native-language certification.
Promotion verifies package integrity, not public publication.
follow_up: Run an independent external French holdout before a quality claim.
Create a future exact-pair package only after its locale and audience are selected.
